mstts:express-as.prosody: As we wrap up, let’s remember—standing at the crossroads between “Should” and “Must” isn’t just a one-time event. It’s a living, breathing part of your journey, a place where you get to shape your life, moment by moment. All the stories and insights we’ve explored aren’t just there to think about—they’re real invitations. Invitations to take action, to lean into what’s calling you, and to make choices that feel true to who you are. So, if you find yourself at one of those crossroads, here’s what I hope you hold onto: Even the smallest, most intentional change can open up space for what you truly love. Setting boundaries? That’s not selfish—it’s an act of self-respect. And your passion? It grows by showing up, practicing, and giving yourself time. Don’t forget, connection and community can make the road less lonely. And finding balance? It isn’t about being perfect. It’s about weaving all these pieces together, day after day. You don’t need all the answers. The path ahead will be messy sometimes, and that’s okay. What matters is that you keep listening—to yourself, to what you need, to that quiet voice that says, “This is what I truly want.” There’ll be days when doubt creeps in, or when the world of “Should” feels way too loud. But you’ll also find moments of clarity, joy, and a sense of fulfillment that’s all your own. So, give yourself permission to start—even if it’s just one small step at a time. Trust that your voice matters, your desires are important, and your life can be shaped by what feels right to you. These crossroads? They’ll keep showing up. And each time, you get to choose—not just once, but every single day. With every choice, you move closer to a life that’s not just lived, but truly your own.
